title: Global Water Resources, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-15
summary: Global Water Resources, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 14, 2026, disclosing a settlement agreement in its GW-Santa Cruz rate case and the planned withdrawal of its GW-Palo Verde rate case with the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC). The settlement agreement and testimony are expected to be filed on April 28, 2026 and May 22, 2026, respectively. This is a company-specific regulatory filing with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: GW-Santa Cruz rate case has settled between the parties
GW-Palo Verde will file a Motion to Withdraw its rate case application with intent to refile in 2027 using a 2026 test year
GW-Palo Verde will seek authorization to increase customer bill credit related to the Southwest Plant
Settlement agreement expected to be filed with ACC on April 28, 2026
Settlement testimony expected to be filed with ACC on May 22, 2026
The company is a water utility registered on NASDAQ under ticker GWRS
